subsequently homogenized in vacuum at 1200 ºC for 48 h and then cooled in the furnace
The homogenized ingots were heated at 1100 ºC for 0.5 h, and immediately hot-rolled to the sheets with a thickness of 8 mm
then cold -rolled to 2.4 mm in thickness with a reduction of 70%
Finally, the cold-rolled sheets were annealed at 1100 ºC for 1 h, followed by air cooling.

mechanisms.name: dislocation motion impeding by shear transformation bands

evidence.quote: These shear transformation bands provide extensive extra interfaces that impede the dislocation motions, leading to an increase in strength.

mechanisms.name: solid-state amorphization driven by dislocation accumulation

evidence.quote: When dislocation accumulation in a constrained shear bands raises the free energy of original fcc phase to a point higher than that of amorphous phase, the energy difference drives amorphization.

mechanisms.name: amorphous-crystalline interface strengthening
mechanisms.material_state: 36% pre-strained and tempered at 700 °C for 1 h

evidence.quote: Owing to the high -density of ACIs, it is believed that ACIs and amorphous bands play a crucial role (as the GB strengthening mechanism) in enhancing yield strength of our pre -strained and tempered samples.
